snippet.title: The Afterlife Cafe - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Afterlife Cafe is available now on Steam and itch.io.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763730/The_Afterlife_Cafe
https://guavapixelstudios.itch.io/the-afterlife-cafe


The Afterlife Cafe is a story about connection, self-discovery, and death. 

Travel to the world of the dead, whose stories encourage reflection on life. Chat with spirits, brew drinks to suit your mood, and bond with the people who run the afterlife cafes.

In this urban sci-fi fantasy visual novel, your choices impact the living, the departed, and your own path forward.
